#why: Antarctica has no government and no capital: the Antarctic Treaty reserves it, and its several competing research stations make no capital (the station rule, 2026-09-15).
Bajo Nuevo Bank is an uninhabited reef, so it has no capital (the station rule, 2026-09-15).
Bir Tawil is unclaimed, uninhabited desert, so it has no capital (the station rule, 2026-09-15).

Bouvet Island is an uninhabited nature reserve administered from Norway, with no seat of its own, so it has no capital (the station rule and the rule for a territory run from outside, both 2026-09-15).

Heard Island and McDonald Islands are uninhabited and administered from Australia, with no seat of their own, so they have no capital (the station rule and the rule for a territory run from outside, both 2026-09-15).
The Siachen Glacier is a glacier with no civil settlement, so it has no capital.
The Spratly Islands are disputed between six claimants with no shared seat, so the card has no capital.
Scarborough Shoal is an uninhabited reef, so it has no capital (the station rule, 2026-09-15).
Serranilla Bank is an uninhabited cay, so it has no capital (the station rule, 2026-09-15).
The Southern Patagonian Ice Field is an icefield and a boundary artifact, so it has no capital.
Tokelau has no capital by design: each of its three atolls administers itself, and the role of head of government rotates between them.
The United States Minor Outlying Islands are a statistical grouping of nine scattered, mostly uninhabited islands rather than an administered territory, so the grouping has no capital.

Port Louis District is the city of Port Louis: Mauritius files its capital as one of its nine districts and the district has no rural remainder, so `Flag of Port Louis, Mauritius.svg`, the municipal flag, is the district's flag as much as the city's. Asunción is a capital district in no department: its own article says 'Administratively, the city forms an autonomous capital district, not a part of any department', so `Escudo de Asunción (Paraguay).svg`, the city's arms (Ordenanza 208/01, on the municipality's 2026 site logo, web:7efc879f6d0ee0c6), is the district's arms as much as the city's (ruled 2026-10-04 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj), under the coextensive-capital ruling of 2026-09-17).

Littoral is the city of Cotonou: French Wikipedia's Littoral (département) says it is 'entièrement formé par la capitale économique du Bénin, Cotonou' (wiki:fr:439698@216075529), so Cotonou's flag and emblem are the department's insignia as much as the city's (ruled 2026-10-13 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): each unit whose stored article shows it is the city's ground takes the city's insignia, under the coextensive-capital ruling of 2026-09-17).

Sofia City Province is Stolichna municipality, Sofia's: 'Област София (столица) включва една-единствена община – Столична община, която покрива цялата територия на областта' (wiki:bg:9646@13022432), so `BG Sofia coa.svg` is the province's arms as much as the city's (ruled 2026-10-13 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): each unit whose stored article shows it is the city's ground takes the city's insignia, under the coextensive-capital ruling of 2026-09-17).

Bulawayo Province is the city of Bulawayo: 'Along with the capital Harare, Bulawayo is one of two cities in Zimbabwe that are also provinces' (wiki:en:355237@1375199079; the infobox's settlement_type 'City, province, district'), so the city's flag and arms are the province's (ruled 2026-10-13 by Jens Nordmark (@nordmarj): each unit whose stored article shows it is the city's ground takes the city's insignia, under the coextensive-capital ruling of 2026-09-17).

ISO's `geographical region` reads as a landform; Uganda's four regions are administrative regions, thin as their role is.
